label: Run $ZED_CUSTOM_java_class_name
command: if (Test-Path 'pom.xml') { mvn clean compile exec:java '-Dexec.mainClass=$ZED_CUSTOM_java_package_name.$ZED_CUSTOM_java_class_name' } elseif ( Test-Path 'gradlew' ) { ./gradlew run '-PmainClass=$ZED_CUSTOM_java_package_name.$ZED_CUSTOM_java_class_name' } else { echo 'No build system found'}

label: Test $ZED_CUSTOM_java_class_name.$ZED_CUSTOM_java_method_name
command: if (Test-Path 'pom.xml') { mvn clean test '-Dtest=$ZED_CUSTOM_java_package_name.$ZED_CUSTOM_java_class_name#$ZED_CUSTOM_java_method_name' } elseif ( Test-Path 'gradlew' ) { ./gradlew test --tests '$ZED_CUSTOM_java_package_name.$ZED_CUSTOM_java_class_name.ZED_CUSTOM_java_method_name' } else { echo 'No build system found'}

label: Test class $ZED_CUSTOM_java_class_name
command: if (Test-Path 'pom.xml') { mvn clean compile test '-Dtest=$ZED_CUSTOM_java_package_name.$ZED_CUSTOM_java_class_name' } elseif ( Test-Path 'gradlew' ) { ./gradlew test --test '$ZED_CUSTOM_java_package_name.$ZED_CUSTOM_java_class_name' } else { echo 'No build system found'}

label: Run tests
command: if (Test-Path 'pom.xml') { mvn clean test } elseif ( Test-Path 'gradlew' ) { ./gradlew test } else { echo 'No build system found'}

label: Clear JDTLS cache
command: $found = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $env:APPDATA -Directory -Filter 'jdtls-*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if ($found.Count -gt 0) { $found | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "Deleting $($_.FullName)"; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Recurse -Force }; Write-Host 'JDTLS cache cleared. Restart the language server' } else { Write-Host "No JDTLS cache found in $env:APPDATA" }
